cards.name: The Wolf's Tooth
cards.upright: The bones fall sharp-end up: a fight is coming, and you will not be the prey.

cards.name: The Crow's Skull
cards.upright: A watcher in the dark. Someone knows more about you than you'd like.

cards.name: The Broken Rib
cards.upright: Something that protected you is cracked. Mend it before it gives way.

cards.name: The Ring of Knuckles
cards.upright: Friends close around you; you are not alone in this.

cards.name: The Hollow Bone
cards.upright: An empty promise. Check what's inside before you take it.

cards.name: The Antler Fork
cards.upright: A choice between two roads, both of them long.

cards.name: The Fish Spine
cards.upright: Travel by water, or a slippery bargain.

cards.name: The Bear's Claw
cards.upright: Strength answers strength. Stand your ground.

cards.name: The Snake Vertebra
cards.upright: A twisting path and a forked tongue. Trust carefully.

cards.name: The Child's Bone
cards.upright: Something new and small that will grow into something great.

cards.name: The Charred Bone
cards.upright: Fire has passed through. What survives is stronger.

cards.name: The Scattered Pile
cards.upright: The bones refuse to speak. The future is your own to make.
